definitions.explanation: The process of creating new land by filling in bodies of water (bays, marshes, rivers) with soil, rubble, or waste. Also refers to waste disposal sites where garbage is buried underground.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{埋|う}め{立|た}て⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This island was created through land reclamation.

examples.japanese: {埋|う}め{立|た}て{地|ち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}ち{並|なら}んでいる→建ち並ぶ：20170_tachinarabu⟧。
examples.english: Apartment buildings line the reclaimed land.

examples.japanese: {東京湾|とうきょうわん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{埋|う}め{立|た}て⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}された→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: Vast areas of land were created through the landfill construction in Tokyo Bay.

notes:
USAGE:
Much of Tokyo's waterfront, including Odaiba and parts of the port area, was created through {埋|う}め{立|た}て. The word can refer to both the process and the resulting land. {埋|う}め{立|た}て{地|ち} (reclaimed land) and {埋|う}め{立|た}て{処分場|しょぶんじょう} (landfill disposal site) are common compound forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {埋|う}め{立|た}て{地|ち}: reclaimed land
- {埋|う}め{立|た}て{処分場|しょぶんじょう}: landfill disposal site
- {埋|う}め{立|た}て⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: landfill construction
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{埋|う}め{立|た}てる: reclaim land from the sea
- {埋|う}め{立|た}て⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: landfill waste
